full_judgment:
Muhammad Abdur Rouf, J: This petition for leave to appeal by the defendant- tenant, is directed against the judgment and order dated 2 February 1995 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division discharging the Rule issued in Civil Revision Case No.1720 of 1992 and affirming thereby a judgment and decree dated 24 May 1992, passed by the Additional District Judge, First Court, Dhaka dismissing Title Appeal No. 273 of 1991 and affirming thereby a decree passed on 29 May 1991 by the Assistant Judge, 4th Additional Court, Dhaka decreeing title Suit No.39 of 1991, a suit for ejectment of the petitioner ---- a monthly tenant. The respondent-landlord instituted the suit alleging inter-alia that the petitioner is an ejectable monthly tenant under him in respect of the suit premises at a monthly rental of Tk. 1,000/-. He defaulted in paying rent since January 1987 and that the suit premises is also required for his use and occupation. A Notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act was served upon the petitioner on 23-11-88, but he did not vacat the suit premises. 

 2. Petitioner contested the suit by filing a written statement denying that he is a defaulter. According to him, the plaintiff with a malafide intention refused to accept the rent for the month of May 1987, whereupon he started depositing the rent with the House Rent Controller in House Rent Control Case No. 6 of 1987. He denied the bonafide requirement of the suit premises by the Respondent. On consideration of both oral and documentary evidence, the trial Court decreed the suit holding that the petitioner was a defaulter and the Respondent required the suit premises bonafide for his use and occupation. The appeal preferred there against was dismissed on contest. By the impugned judgment the High Court Division has refused to interefere with the decree.
